programs.name: Solstice program
programs.upgradeAuthorityKind: fetched via getAccountInfo on ProgramData PDA

governanceModel: Two multisigs. Main 3/5 with 24h timelock (strong). Vault-parent 2/3 with 0 timelock (weak - this owns the program).
gaps: Why does the program-owner have WEAKER governance than the main multisig? Inverse of best practice.
notes: Solstice has a notable asymmetry: the main multisig that controls treasury has strong governance (3/5 + 24h TL) but the multisig that owns the actual PROGRAM has weak governance (2/3 + 0s). This means program upgrades have weaker protection than treasury.
